name: Chemin des Douaniers
description_md:
Chemin des Douaniers is a waymarked hiking route located in France. The route is signposted as GR 34 and belongs to the national waymarked hiking network.

This hard route covers a distance of 2093.3 km with 24431 m of ascent and 24427 m of descent. The walking time is about 588 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule, and the line matches the official route published by ign_bdtopo. Nearby places include Hôtel Saint-Pierre within 100 m, Ramparts of Mont Saint-Michel within 100 m, and Vieux logis within 200 m.
